[[File:Corellian_princess_ring.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ring gifted to Queen Rana by the Corellian princess]]
A '''princess''' ruled on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Mission">''[[Mission from Mount Yoda]]''</ref> At some point after the [[Duro/Legends|Duros]] made first contact with the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]], the [[Princess/Legends|princess]] befriended the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of Duros, [[Rana Mas Trehalt]]. She gifted Queen Rana a [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] [[Ring/Legends|ring]], which would later be [[Burial/Legends|entombed]] with her in the [[Valley of Royalty]].<ref name="Mission" /> At one point, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] evacuated the Valley's artifacts from the [[Trioculus' Empire|Empire]]. The princess' ring was gifted to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] by the Duros [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] [[Dustangle]] as a sign of gratitude.<ref name="Mission" /> Solo would use the ancient ring as a wedding ring for [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] during their [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa (5 ABY)|first marriage attempt]].<ref name="QueenOfTheEmpire">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''</ref>
